what: Cursor archetype labels are not normalized for parse-rate retry
scenario_or_breakage: After cutover VOTER_N_TOOL becomes cursor-validity or similar. A NOT_SUBSTANTIVE Cursor voter reaches launch_voter_retry with that label, hits unknown voter retry tool, and never retries despite the plan preserving parse-rate retry.
suggested_fix: Normalize cursor-* labels to launcher tool cursor for retry launch while preserving the archetype label for diagnostics and TSV attribution.

what: Effective voter filtering can desynchronize new voter labels from voter files
scenario_or_breakage: When one archetype voter is removed by parse-rate diag, EFFECTIVE_VOTER_FILES compacts but the proposed --voter-labels list can still reflect the original three slots. The next surviving vote can be written under the wrong vN_tool.
suggested_fix: Build EFFECTIVE_VOTER_LABELS in the same loop that builds EFFECTIVE_VOTER_FILES, and write vN_tool from that filtered list.
